title: Translates of an orthonormally spanned subspace are embedded C^r submanifolds
statement: Let P, d, r ∈ ℕ. Let Q ⊆ ℝ^P (= Euclid P) be a linear subspace, let τ = (τ_0, …, τ_{d−1}) : Fin d → ℝ^P be an orthonormal family with span{τ_0, …, τ_{d−1}} = Q, and let a ∈ ℝ^P. Then the translate A := {y ∈ ℝ^P : y + a ∈ Q} = Q − a is a d-dimensional embedded C^r submanifold in the sense of IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d A. That is, for every y ∈ A there exist an open V ⊆ ℝ^d, an open W ⊆ ℝ^P with y ∈ W, and a map ψ : ℝ^d → ℝ^P such that: ψ is C^r on V; ψ is injective on V; ψ(V) = W ∩ A; V ∩ ψ^{−1}(K) is compact for every compact K ⊆ W; and the derivative fderiv ℝ ψ z is injective for every z ∈ V.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d r : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (τ : Fin d → Euclid P) (a : Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) = Q → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d {y | y + a ∈ Q}
